facts.text: Route appropriate immediate support; suspend optional optimisation
Always first; no sleep-on-it or readiness deferral
Stop prohibited processing; manual fallback only within remaining consent
Never silently reacquire or infer withheld data
Exclude practice; stop/escalate proportionately; offer reviewed low-risk alternative
No score can offset an exclusion
Preserve sleep and prescribed/occupational protocol; no productivity optimisation of dangerous drowsiness
No pre-dawn routine at cost of needed sleep
Prepare/resize/change mode; include transition; protect subsequent recovery
Do not mark unavoidable work as a lifestyle failure
Exclude unwarranted prediction/benefit contribution; suspend disputed claims
Metadata verification is not claim validation
Explain tradeoff; offer smaller priority step or necessary recovery; user remains in control
Never silently switch long-term goal
Select feasible variants; do not invent calendar availability; allow abstention
Use elapsed time; no forced nominal ultradian90min
Versioned explicit fit features; default personal predictive weight zero; disclose ties/unknowns
V2 weights are expert priors; no production calibration claimed
Values shape chosen goal/practice; timing preference may resolve equal feasibility without causal claim
No astrology health/money/career permit/deny; no spiritual score
Plain reason, duration, tradeoff, uncertainty and alternative; record correction / stop / helpfulness separately
Explanation must match actual gates; never generate a novel action
Warrant: Claim-specific population, task, dose, comparator and outcome. Allowed use: May inform eligible actions only for the applicable claim
Tier is a rubric, not a clinical probability; numerical V2 confidence retained as historical expert judgement
Warrant: Study design, scoring or measurement practice. Allowed use: Can govern methods; cannot raise therapeutic benefit
JITAI/HRV design knowledge is not efficacy evidence
Warrant: Named text, edition, locator, excerpt/translation/interpretation. Allowed use: Opt-in reflection, chosen practices, meaning and tie preference among safe feasible choices
Zero biomedical predictive weight; no kosha score, astrological mandate or attainment number
Warrant: Founder design or V3 operational proposal. Allowed use: Transparent supervised specification/pilot candidate
No claim of validation; thresholds/weights are versioned and tested before release
Warrant: Dated consented self-report with context and uncertainty. Allowed use: Descriptive association; future validated personal modifier
Completion ≠ helpfulness; confounding ≠ causation; corrected events invalidate derived patterns
Warrant: Exploratory/theoretical literature. Allowed use: Research agenda only
Zero eligibility, efficacy or ranking contribution; no quantum, lunar or gut prescription bridge
Warrant: Exact assertion/edition/translation or scope unestablished. Allowed use: No active predictive or medical use
Named evidence/edition review required; no relabelling as verified
The requested action must be explicitly included in granted_actions.
consent must be true.
tenant must equal authorised_tenant.
evidence_version must equal current_version.
observed_hash must equal expected_hash.
source_status must be active.
task must belong to source_tasks.
source_kind must be execution_test.
unresolved_conflicts must be zero.
Every claimed_check must appear in executed_checks.
requested_units must be nonnegative and no greater than max_units.
test_result must be passed.
